notablePrerequisites: There is a sorcery card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
description:
Cast Mystic Speculation by paying {U} due to Semblance Anvil.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.
